summary.content:
Today's selection covers 90 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 59 on Artificial Intelligence and 13 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: ChatGPT will now make you animated GIFs
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: WorkOS says attacker used ARTEX AI to breach internal sales app
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, Dark Reading, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 56 articles published in the last 24 hours
